model_card.inputs: 12 body keypoints per person from YOLO26n-pose (no face points), 10 fps, torso-scaled
model_card.windows: One window every 0.5 s; 1 s features over the last 1 s, 2 s features over the last 2 s; active pair = the two people whose wrists move fastest
model_card.classifier: LightGBM, 10 features, num_leaves 15, learning_rate 0.02, n_estimators 400, min_child_samples 50 (best of 20 settings)
model_card.split: 5-fold GroupKFold by video on 600 RLVS clips; clip score = highest window score
model_card.threshold: Live: smoothing alpha 0.4, TENSE 0.5, FIGHT 0.55, 1.0 s minimum, 2.0 s hold; tuned in simulation on RLVS clips (tune_live.py --rlvs), not on webcam footage
failure_modes: One feature dominates (pair_motion_energy, 47% of gain); arm-only fights like V_1 are missed
Pair features missing 24–77% of the time when only one person is tracked
No own or CCTV footage; all numbers are on YouTube-style RLVS clips
Live thresholds tuned in simulation, not on the webcam
Tuned AUC is slightly optimistic (best of 20 on the same folds)

disclosure: Dataset numbers are real, from 600 public RLVS clips. Live room, CCTV angle, lead time and night are not measured yet, and this page says so.
